- Harbor Club Grill — Lively tavern, moderate prices, burgers, wings, flatbreads, and a few salads; easy group seating.
- Orchard House — Stylish vegan restaurant, higher prices, mostly comfort-food remakes in a more polished, slower dinner format.
- Bell Street Noodle Bar — Casual noodle counter, lower prices, mostly meat-based broths, one tofu option, quicker table turnover.
